# officecrypto-tool browser bundle

`officecrypto.min.js` bundles `officecrypto-tool` 0.0.19 and its browser polyfills for local, in-browser decryption of password-protected Office files.

- Upstream: https://github.com/zurmokeeper/officecrypto-tool
- License: MIT
- Passwords and decrypted workbook bytes remain in the browser memory and are not uploaded by this module.
